'''Rennith''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] who was sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he, along with [[Jurithus]], [[Avoira]], and [[Sathun]], joined a group of slave rebels to fight against their Imperial enslavers and escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. However, he and his friends were all killed in the skirmish.
